Thank you for sharing your symptoms. I understand you're experiencing progressively worsening diffuse abdominal pain, distension, and nausea. To help me understand your condition better, I need to ask you some focused questions.

First, how long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and did they start suddenly or gradually?

Second, have you had any vomiting, and if so, what was the content (food, bile, blood)? Also, have you noticed any changes in your bowel movements - such as constipation, diarrhea, or inability to pass gas?

message.content:
Well, the pain and distension have been getting worse over the past few days. It didn't start all of a sudden - it's been kind of gradual, but definitely getting worse as time goes on.

I've been feeling really nauseous, but I haven't actually vomited.

As for my bowels... I haven't really been paying close attention, to be honest. I don't think I've had any diarrhea. I'm not sure about constipation or passing gas - nothing really stands out to me as different, but I've been so focused on the pain.
